purpose: Independent forward-test prompts. Evaluators receive the skill and raw inputs, not an intended answer.

scenarios.prompt: Create a publishable article for marketing teams explaining how to use generative AI for SEO content without violating current Google guidance. Use current official sources and do not invent ranking effects.
Rewrite the supplied weak article about meta-description length. Preserve its approved URL and useful official link, correct any unsupported hard character limit, and provide a traceable diff.
Refresh the supplied article that recommends FAQ schema for every blog post. Use current Google documentation, change only stale sections, and justify dateModified.
